data.desc: WisdomTree is a modern global asset manager with capabilities across public markets, private markets, tokenization and onchain finance. We offer a diverse suite of exchange-traded products, models and solutions, private market investments and blockchain-enabled products and services, helping investors shape their financial future and financial professionals grow their businesses. Through WisdomTree Onchain, we combine tokenized investment products, infrastructure and distribution capabilities into an integrated financial services platform serving retail and institutional investors. WisdomTree currently has approximately $175 billion in assets under management globally, inclusive of assets managed by Ceres as of the last reportable period.
